definitions.fuelRate: Average fuel rate = total fuel amount ÷ total litres. Weighted by litres, so a full tank counts for more than a top-up — not an average of individual rates.
definitions.operationalSpend: Operational spend = fuel + RTO + tyre + tyre insurance + maintenance/service, from their own records. Archived records are excluded.
definitions.operatingCost: Operating cost = fuel + RTO + tyre + tyre insurance + maintenance in the period. EMI is finance and is never added to it.
definitions.outstandingFinance: Total outstanding finance = the outstanding balance recorded on each active vehicle loan. Loans with no recorded balance are not estimated.
definitions.ledger: Recorded outflow and inflow from the finance ledger. Corrections appear as negative reversal lines on the day they were made. This is an operational summary, not statutory accounts.
definitions.paid: Only payments with status Paid. Reversed, failed, cancelled and in-progress payments are never counted as paid.
definitions.salaries: Net payable of salaries whose pay month falls in the period. Cancelled salaries are excluded.
definitions.pending: Payments awaiting approval, approved, processing or awaiting a status check — right now, whenever they were created.
definitions.verified: A person checked the receipt and verified the record. Only this counts as verified.
definitions.aiReading: AI has read the receipt, but nobody has verified it yet. AI readings are suggestions, not records.
definitions.pendingVerification: Records with a receipt that AI has read, is reading or failed to read, which no person has verified or rejected yet.
definitions.tyres: Tyre purchases and replacements (tyre expense records) plus tyre-insurance premiums dated in the period.
definitions.missing: A required document with no current record: RC, insurance, PUC, tyre insurance, fitness and permit for each active vehicle; a driving licence for each driver. Never counted as expired.
definitions.stops: Stationary alerts raised in the period. Duration runs from when the driver stopped until they moved or the alert was closed.
definitions.neverReported: Active drivers whose phone has never sent a location.
definitions.noScores: These are counts and totals from each driver's records. No performance or efficiency score is calculated.
definitions.notAccounts: Financial Summary is an operational view of recorded money movements. It is not a balance sheet, profit and loss statement or GST return.
